answer: A tide of cheap fake identities only wins when creating them costs nothing. Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that decays slowly: a Sybil operator must fund every identity, and when one is caught cheating, its stake is slashed, sending a ripple through the whole cluster as linked wallets lose funds at once. Verification should also check real work history: hollow accounts with no completed jobs, no counterparties, and no reputation earn no trust, no matter how many of them appear. Attackers then face a simple choice: pay heavily for each fake, or stay out.
